task.description: Produce the design artefact (lib/letflow/design/req176-dlq-core.md or similar) for REQ-176: a new dlq_entries Ecto schema/migration (tenant-scoped per decision 0003 Decision B) and a context module implementing enqueue/1, list/2, get/2, retry/2, discard/2 exactly per the requirement's own field-by-field and state-machine specification. Design must specify: (1) the exact Ecto schema/migration field list and types (id uuid pk, entry_type string, instance_id nullable, reference_id nullable, reason, full_reason, error_detail jsonb, error_chain jsonb array, source_payload jsonb, context_json jsonb, retry_history jsonb array shaped like DlqRetryAttempt, retry_count integer default 0, retry_limit nullable, next_retry_at nullable, status string with values pending|retrying|resolved|discarded, created_at, first_failed_at, last_failed_at); (2) list/2's cursor-pagination mechanism -- specify the actual cursor encoding/decoding approach and ordering column(s) used, matching CursorPage<DlqEntry>'s {items, next_cursor} shape, and confirm it composes correctly with independent entry_type and status filters plus free-text search across reason/instance_id/id; (3) retry/2 and discard/2's exact state-machine transitions and conflict-error shape for invalid-state calls (four distinct starting-status cases for retry/2 per the acceptance criteria: pending, retrying, resolved, discarded); (4) that no route/controller is included in this requirement's own scope (REQ-178's job) -- the design should not describe any Plug route. Design only -- no implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: the dlq_entries table lives inside each tenant's Postgres schema with a tenant_id column retained, matching decision 0003 Decision B's pattern -- verified by inspecting the migration

enqueue/1 creates an entry with status "pending", retry_count 0, and a created_at timestamp; list/2 is tenant-scoped, demonstrated by an entry enqueued under tenant A being absent from a list/2 call scoped to tenant B

retry/2 on a "pending" or "retrying" entry transitions it to "retrying", appends a retry_history entry with attempt_no/attempted_at/outcome/error_message field names matching DlqRetryAttempt exactly, and increments retry_count; retry/2 on a "resolved" or "discarded" entry returns a conflict error and leaves status, retry_count and retry_history unchanged -- four tests, one per starting status
discard/2 on a "pending" or "retrying" entry transitions it to "discarded"; discard/2 on an already "resolved" or "discarded" entry returns a conflict error rather than silently succeeding

list/2 filters by entry_type and by status independently, each demonstrated narrowing a result set that contains rows of more than one value, and supports cursor pagination: given more rows than one page, the first page's next_cursor, passed back in, returns the next distinct page with no repeated or skipped ids
no route or controller file is added or modified, confirmed by git diff --stat scoped to this requirement's commits
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
